goal: Make automatic production qualification ask the production gate's own evidence question before dispatch: run the unchanged historical original-apply proof, fall back to the gate's existing ephemeral-CI route only for non-high-risk migrations, and otherwise refuse without dispatching. No comparison is loosened.
prohibited_actions: No schema, migration, database claim, preview or production database write.
No production workflow dispatch and no GitHub settings change.
No loosening of any production evidence comparison.
assumptions: The production apply lane already accepts ephemeral_check_run_id for non-high-risk migrations and re-runs every proof itself.
stop_conditions: Stop if the fix would require changing prove_historical_original_apply_runs, preview_required_reasons or prove_ephemeral_ci_evidence.
